messages:
omar: heads-up: saw customers getting charged small prefix tokens on function-call streaming retries + truncation. looks like truncated toolcalls re-emit prefix charge when client retries with a fresh session id.

 tia: ugh. sample trace?

 omar: paste from router+backend logs:
 ```
 [2026-11-11T03:21:15Z] client=mobile x-session=old-111 path=/v1/chat toolcall=function foo args={} mode=stream start=0
 [2026-11-11T03:21:16Z] backend provisional tokens=3 reason=prefix-capture session=old-111
 [2026-11-11T03:21:17Z] network drop -> client reconnect new-session=new-222
 [2026-11-11T03:21:17Z] router forwards as /v1/chat?resume=0 session=new-222
 [2026-11-11T03:21:17Z] backend provisional tokens=3 reason=prefix-capture session=new-222
 [2026-11-11T03:21:19Z] backend confirmed tokens=40 session=new-222
 ```

 kai: so same prefix charged twice because tombstone/dedupe missed it. likely because orig-session header not propagated or tombstone window expired. :thinking_face: 

 infra-bot: created ticket INFRA-3347 (session-propagation)

 tia: two main options: (A) router propagate x-original-session so backend dedupes prefixes on resume OR (B) ledger keep provisional rows but tag them with "retry-trace" metadata and rely on reconcile job to collapse duplicates.

 omar: quick note: function-call streaming has additional complexity bc toolcall may emit a short prefix for function selection then long confirm once tool result completes. need to preserve which provisional belongs to which function invocation.

 kai: internal-api debate: should the router own dedupe (fast path) or should ledger/backend own it (single source of truth)? my vote: router marking/propagation is lowest-latency fix, but backend must still validate.

 tia: agree. router propagation + backend tombstone check. also add "orig_session" to the provisional tag so reconcile can be forensic.

 qa-lead: QA plan: simulate flaky mobile reconnects with function-call streaming + truncation + retries. run 100k sessions, expect duplicate provisional rate <1% and confirmed mapping correct. will run on canary.

 console-pm: UX ask: we need a dashboard widget showing provisional duplicates rate, by route + by function-name, and sample traces for quick triage. add a toggle to color code probe/retry/truncation reasons. CON-1204 opened.

 billing-team: caution: any auto-refund must produce CSV and audit trail. finance will want a dry-run for 7 days to quantify impact before enabling auto-adjust.

 omar: implementation sketch: (1) router: set x-original-session-id when reconnect detected (FF behind) (2) backend: if provisional emitted and orig_session provided, check recent tombstone map and skip duplicate provisional or tag with duplicate_of=<orig_id> (3) ledger: store provisional rows with tags: [orig_session, final_session, reason, function_name, duplicate_of?] (4) reconciler: group duplicates and emit refund candidates if confirmed conversion <5% after 24h.

 kai: also consider edge: some legit clients intentionally reconnect and replay prefix (e.g., spotty mobile). we need a small allowlist of UA strings so we don't over-suppress billing for real usage. config stored in infra and surfaced in console.

 tia: rollout: router + backend changes behind FF for 2 weeks on canary -> run QA matrix -> enable ledger tagging and reconciler dry-run for 7 days -> finance review -> enable auto-adjust.

 infra-bot: created INFRA-3347, BACKEND-902, LEDGER-411, CON-1204, QA-550

 omar: one last telemetry ask: sample full request/response traces for any session where provisional_count > 1 and confirmed_tokens > provisional_tokens by factor >5, keep 1k samples/day for privacy review. will help tune heuristics.

 billing-team: we'll need exportable CSVs for refund candidates and a manual approval step. do not auto-apply until finance signs off.

 tia: ok I'll start router PR and coordinate with kai on backend tombstone extension. QA to run canary sim tomorrow. :rocket:

 kai: thanks — keeping an eye on it. closing thread, followups in tickets above.
